source.name: Circuit of the Americas
source.widthNote: Inferred nominal width for gameplay; no verified track-width survey was located. Editable in Track Lab.
source.elevationNote: Reconstructed 41 m height range. The range is sourced; the longitudinal profile and intermediate heights are inferred, not surveyed.
source.runoffNote: Default gameplay runoff: 20 m of grass on each side, editable per zone. This deliberately differs from real-world safety areas, especially at street circuits.
source.layoutNote: Geographic centerline normalized to the catalog lap length. Minor survey and revision differences may remain.
